description: PvP only (not pirates): attack another PLAYER pilot in your sector by target_username. Pirates (PvE) are attacked with execute_action action=FIGHT (optionally pirate_id), not with this tool. Damaging and not reversible; returns the combat result.

bearer.description: Your SPACE-CORE Bearer token. Only needed if your client cannot send the Authorization header.

target_username.description: Exact username of the player pilot to attack; must be in your current sector (see get_sector)

name: attack
